class.name: RosClient
class.brief_description: A ROS 2 Service Client for making requests to a service server.
class.description: [RosClient] allows Godot to act as a client for ROS 2 services. It is created through [method RosNode.create_client] and is used to send requests and receive responses asynchronously. Communication follows a request-response pattern: the client sends a [RosMsg] and eventually receives a [RosMsg] response via the [signal request_completed] signal.

method.name: async_send_request
method.description: Sends a service [param request] to the server. This method returns immediately. When the response is received, the [signal request_completed] signal is emitted with the result.

method.name: create_request
method.description: Creates and returns a new [RosMsg] instance pre-configured with the correct request type for this service.

method.name: wait_for_service
method.description: Blocks the current thread until the service becomes available or the [param timeout_sec] is reached. Returns [code]true[/code] if the service is ready. [b]Warning:[/b] Calling this with a long timeout on the main thread will cause the Godot editor or game to freeze.
